_about: Experiment registry for the daily Shorts. pipeline/experiments.py assigns arms (assign) and scores them from episodes/analytics.json (report). The daily run edits this file: it concludes tests, promotes winners to defaults, and starts new tests from the backlog. Keep 3-6 tests active.

music.why: george 2026-11-25: every Short so far used the same procedural pluck loop for its style | 2026-11-25 evening: george wants upbeat or dramatic music to match high-stakes content, so the test is narrowed to epic, hype (new), suspense and chiptune; pluck, lofi, musicbox and none dropped.

ending_cta.why: george 2026-11-25: which call to action earns follows/comments without losing the end of the video

narrator.why: only am_michael has been used on lowpoly; voice is a big part of retention in faceless Shorts | 2026-11-25: george wants women's and softer voices A/B tested: added af_bella (warm US female), af_nicole (soft, breathy US female) and bf_emma (British female). | af_nicole dropped 27 Nov: george said it sounded like whispering.

speed.why: pacing: competitors cut every 2.5-3.5 s and talk fast; we've only tried 1.16-1.2

hook_form.why: question 'What happens if you...?' / statement 'You just got struck by lightning.' / number first '1,000 bees. 30 seconds.' / dare 'Would you...?' / he_statement (george 27 Nov, RicksClips style, for told-straight stories) 'He got shot in the chest, then did a speech straight after.'

content_vars._about: Chosen by the writer to fit the idea, not assigned, but always recorded in experiment.vars so the report can compare them.

george to upload at the suggested time
